dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries with end-stage renal disease who use home dialysis, as well as qualified medical personnel providing home dialysis respite care.
dimensions.evidence: furnished to a patient with end-stage renal disease

dimensions.assessment: Provides new Medicare benefits and payment adjustments for home dialysis support services and mental health care.
dimensions.evidence: include certain additional services as self-care home dialysis support services under the Medicare program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes non-budget-neutral payment adjustments for respite care and mental health services sessions, though total aggregate federal spending impacts are not explicitly totaled.
dimensions.evidence: Any payment adjustment under subparagraph (D)(iv) for staff-assisted home dialysis respite care shall not be made in a budget neutral manner.

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act to expand covered self-care home dialysis support services under Medicare.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1881(b)(9) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395rr(b)(9)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent addition of benefits under Medicare beginning January 1, 2028.
dimensions.evidence: beginning January 1, 2028, staff-assisted home dialysis respite care furnished to a patient

missing_information: The total fiscal cost to the Medicare program is not estimated in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands Medicare coverage to include staff-assisted home dialysis respite care and renal mental health services for certain patients, introducing specific payment adjustments.
